title: Source: Dobbins back to Broncos for 2 years, $20M

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Source: Dobbins back to Broncos for 2 years, $20M
sources.description: The Broncos are bringing back running back J.K. Dobbins on a two-year, $20 million deal that includes $8 million fully guaranteed at signing, NFL Network reported Monday.
